question: What product did Robot.com unveil in August 2026?

hits.title: Meet R-Dog, the robot dog that climbs stairs with packages.
hits.snippet: Robot.com is developing the quadruped for commercial work.

hits.title: Robot.com unveils R-dog: A four-legged Robotic platform Designed to deliver, advertise, and engage.
hits.snippet: Designed to run on REMI, Robot.com's fleet management and physical API layer, the concept robot will evolve into a production version through an expanded collaboration with FieldAI, whose general-purpose Field Foundation Models will serve as the robot's autonomy brain.

hits.title: Built for the work that burns people out.
hits.snippet: Robot.com partnered with Yukai Engineering for design and R-soul, an expression system designed to earn trust.

hits.title: Delivery robot startup Robot.com is betting its next act on workplace humanoids.
